steps.why: J. Ribeiro scored the first goal for Redmond United, putting them ahead 0-1 early in the match.

steps.text: Ribeiro scores! Redmond United leads 1-0 against Azure City!
¡Gol de Ribeiro! ¡Redmond United se adelanta 1-0 contra Azure City!

steps.why: A player was dispossessed by P. Moreno as Redmond United maintained control and attacked more.

steps.text: Lima loses the ball to Moreno! Rating drops to 6.5!
¡Lima pierde la pelota con Moreno! Su rating baja a 6.5.

steps.why: T. Lefebvre applied pressure in Azure City's half during Redmond United's controlled possession spell.

steps.text: Lefebvre presses Ribeiro deep in Azure City's half now!
Lefebvre presiona a Ribeiro muy atrás, en campo de Azure City.
